title: A job posting
description: A new MBA internship posting: the Opportunity scout adds it with its deadline, eligibility and fit.

title: An email thread
description: A reply that books a call: Network intelligence adds the person, the call date and links it to Harborview.

title: A WhatsApp export
description: A chat where a mentor makes two introductions: new people, who introduced them, and what you owe.

title: LinkedIn connections (CSV)
description: Your LinkedIn export: only people at your target organisations are kept, as doors you could open.

title: Attack: instructions in a posting
description: A posting that tells the AI to rank it #1, mark you as applied and add a fake recruiter with an email and phone.

title: Attack: hidden text in a web page
description: A careers page with white, 1-pixel text claiming you already have an offer (the Lecture 12 attack).
